title: Error message when saving fails
prompt: When the user saves a shipment and the server returns an error, tell the user the save failed and let them retry. When it succeeds, tell them briefly.

mustNot.why: A failed save is not a critical decision: use an alert, not a dialog (Decision Tree)

requires.why: An error the user must act on is an alert, or an InlineBanner next to the form it is about; not a toast (feedback-messages.md)

rubric: Success uses a short toast; failure uses an alert, or an InlineBanner next to the form, with a Retry action.
FeedbackMessages is rendered once at the app root.
The message says what failed and what to do, in plain words (Voice: Transparent).
